speaker: Ms Yeo Wan Ling
text: asked the Minister for Manpower in view of the recent announcement by a food delivery platform company to exit Singapore market which affects workers’ livelihoods, (a) what protections are in place to support the affected workers; (b) whether platform companies are required to provide notice and transition assistance; and (c) whether additional measures will be introduced to strengthen redeployment and income support during such disruptions.

speaker: Ms Yeo Wan Ling (Punggol)
text: Could the Ministry elaborate how the Government ensures that platform operators have clearer responsibilities to their workers in such situations, particularly in terms of data, transparency and workers communication?

speaker: Ms Yeo Wan Ling (Punggol)
text: So that our workers can receive timely information on changes that will affect their livelihoods and so that they can make informed decisions early.

speaker: Ms Yeo Wan Ling (Punggol)
text: And also, in light of such exits, could the Ministry also clarify whether there are plans to put in place a more structured framework, including coordinated support across agencies and industries?

speaker: Ms Yeo Wan Ling (Punggol)
text: I recall for this particular case, we had our Singapore Manual and Mercantile Workers' Association, as well as the National Delivery Champions Association from the National Trades Union Congress (NTUC) coming in.

speaker: Ms Yeo Wan Ling (Punggol)
text: But I do think that it would be good to have better coordination, so that there will be proactive matches to support our affected workers to alternative platforms or jobs.

speaker: Ms Yeo Wan Ling (Punggol)
text: And how do we ensure that the workers do not face prolonged income disruption, as well as hardship, and what kind of supports do we have for them during this transition?

speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
text: To share more, platform operators and platform work associations should continue their bilateral discussions on the information that can be provided to workers.

speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
text: So, I encourage NTUC to continue with these discussions and use these platforms to do it collaboratively.

speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
text: In addition, there will always be disruptions when there are transitions.
